question.prompt: The diameter of \(\odot O\) is \(8\), and the length of chord \(AB\) is an integer. How many possible values are there for the length of \(AB\)?

solutions.explanation: The chord length satisfies \(0<AB\leq8\) (the diameter is the longest chord). The integer values are \(1\) through \(8\), giving \(8\) possibilities.
solutions.title: List the integer chord lengths
